perturbed_solution: Let the sides perpendicular to the barn be of length $x$. Notice that there are a total of $1200/5=200$ feet of fencing. Therefore, the side parallel to the barn has length $200-2x$, so the area to be maximized is $200x-2x^2+100$. Completing the square results in $-2(x-50)^2+720$, which is maximized when $x=50$. Therefore, the side parallel to the barn has length $200-2(50)=\boxed{100}$ feet.

errors.rationale: Dividing 1200 by 5 gives 240, not 200; this arithmetic error changes the total available fencing.
The area should be x(200-2x)=200x-2x^2; adding an extra 100 square feet is an unjustified additive constant and changes the objective function.
The constant 720 drops a zero and makes the completed-square form incorrect; completing the square of the stated area would produce a much larger constant.
